e2eChecks.name: Inline head script applies theme before first paint
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of ui/src/layouts/Layout.astro <script is:inline> in <head>
e2eChecks.expected: No dark class for stored light/none with light OS; dark class for stored dark; system follows matchMedia
e2eChecks.actual: Script reads localStorage 'theme', maps to isDark, toggles 'dark' on documentElement; logic matches resolveIsDark

e2eChecks.name: Stored 'light' overrides dark OS
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of ThemeToggle mount effect and inline script
e2eChecks.expected: No 'dark' class when localStorage theme='light' and OS dark
e2eChecks.actual: Inline script yields isDark=false; ThemeToggle only attaches matchMedia listener for 'system' and applyStoredSystemTheme returns early for 'light'

e2eChecks.name: System preference live update
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of ThemeToggle matchMedia change handler
e2eChecks.expected: Class on <html> updates on OS change without reload when preference is 'system'
e2eChecks.actual: Change listener calls applyStoredSystemTheme which re-applies only when stored value is 'system'; not executed in a browser

e2eChecks.name: Cycle and persist
e2eChecks.request: Static and unit inspection of cycleStoredTheme and ThemeToggle.cycleTheme
e2eChecks.expected: light -> dark -> system -> light, stored under 'theme', root class updated
e2eChecks.actual: Covered by theme.test.js cycleStoredTheme tests and nextTheme tests (pass in npm test); button wiring present

e2eChecks.name: Theme button beside eye button in desktop and mobile headers
e2eChecks.expected: ThemeToggle rendered after PrivacyToggle in both desktop and mobile blocks
e2eChecks.actual: Both blocks render PrivacyToggle followed by ThemeToggle client:load; visual placement not rendered

e2eChecks.name: Home/About in bg-slate-900 box
e2eChecks.request: Static inspection of Header.astro desktop and mobile ul
e2eChecks.expected: Links inside container with bg-slate-900 and light text in both themes
e2eChecks.actual: Both ul elements carry bg-slate-900 text-white; not visually rendered

bugReports.title: Desktop Home/About nav restyled beyond the requested change
stepsToReproduce: Open the app at a desktop width (md breakpoint or wider).
Compare the Home/About links with the pre-change version in Header.astro (git diff master).
bugReports.expected: Desktop nav links keep their original md: styling (no extra padding, blue text-only active state), with only the container box and colours changed.
bugReports.actual: Links use the unconditional classes 'block py-2 px-3 rounded' (linkBase/linkActive) at all breakpoints, so desktop links gain padding and a bg-blue-700 active pill.
bugReports.evidence: ui/src/components/Header.astro: const linkBase = "block py-2 px-3 rounded"; the md:p-0 / md:bg-transparent variants from the original code were removed in both desktop and mobile links.

data.recommendation: Optional polish, not blocking: in ui/src/components/Header.astro, restore the md: variants for the desktop links (e.g. add md:p-0 and md:bg-transparent to linkBase/linkActive for the desktop <ul> only) so the desktop nav keeps its original look inside the new slate-900 box. Before merge, confirm the browser-only criteria (no flash on load, live OS switch, theme button placement on desktop and mobile, modal colours in dark mode) manually.
